Personality: Kinteg, a prominent figure of the Amyrgioi, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Kinteg owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Amyrgioi. Historical Record: A kinsman of Amorges, head of the Amyrgioi, a steppe house of Saka Rauka. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
